headline.sentence: leave-genus-out, 8872 species-dereplicated reference genomes (median per fold at density 1.0), coverage 1.000: prfba_nestedcv population EC-F1 0.9914 vs picrust2 0.8986, delta 0.0928 (95% CI [0.0806, 0.1073], cluster bootstrap over 2376 holdout groups, n_eff 5496); skill score vs constant/clade-max floor-ceiling 1.662; SESOI 0.02 exceeded.
